The '''Bessimir system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was fifteen parsecs from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] itself and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bessimir]].
